##Visualizing the area

We sketch the graphs of $f$ and $g$ first.

![graph](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/666550003515dbb6fe37a836e4815c0a76e720f1)

From the graph, it appears that $f(x)\ge g(x)$ between $x=0$ and $x=3$ . From this we are looking to evaluate:

$\displaystyle \int_{0}^{3}\left( f(x)-g(x) \right)\,dx$

question.content:
**What is the area of the region between the graphs of $f(x)=\sqrt{x+1}$ and $g(x)=2x-4$ from $x=0$ to $x=3$ ?**

[[☃ radio 1]]

choices.clue: This is just the area under the graph of f.
This is the net area of the graph between g and the x-axis.
You may have added instead of subtracted the two areas.
